availability_policy: Apply the existing monthly lags; do not infer historical publication timestamps from month labels. Actual future issuance still requires timely source receipts.
hypothesis: Eight global SST principal components add information to the fixed lagged hybrid.
paired_inputs: Identical samples, targets, base features, climatologies and ridge. Append eight PCs only to the two tree models.
primary_metric: Pooled full-grid RMSE: SST candidate minus paired hybrid.
prior_use: Both years were used in earlier final fits and have already been evaluated in the hybrid/U-Net temporal extension. This is an additional retrospective check, not a fresh holdout.
